text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day when I went out into town, I saw Meisho Doto bowing politely to a statue in front of the station...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, I'm truly sorry!
Are you hurt? Did your clothes get dirty?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Um, while I was walking,
my legs felt heavy and I tripped.
And then, I bumped right into this person...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The shock made your face turn so pale...
Wait, huh? W-What?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A st-st-statue?
Why on earth am I apologizing to a bronze statue~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto might be carrying quite a bit of fatigue...
It would be wise to reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
